package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestMigration026MakesActionSourceImmutableAndKeepsPracticeOutOfCourseClosure(t *testing.T) {
	payload, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/026_student_practice_learning_action.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sql := string(payload)
	for _, expected := range []string{
		"IF NEW.source_kind IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source_kind THEN",
		"IF OLD.source_kind = 'course_answer' THEN",
		"source_kind = 'practice_v2'",
		"lifecycle_status IN ('RESERVED', 'OPEN', 'CANCELLED')",
		"fk_student_learning_action_owned_path",
		"uq_student_learning_action_practice_active_path_revision",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(sql, expected) {
			t.Fatalf("migration 024 is missing %q", expected)
		}
	}
}
